name: takeover
description: Full-game renderer acceptance captures. takeover-drive moves and aims on seed 7, fires through #fire, waits for a recorded flash and then a committed terrain edit in the aim phase, and compares DOM labels with rendered-frame projection plus an independent camera projection. takeover-perf records idle and shot/edit frames at 1280x720. takeover-gpu1080 compares gameplay and planet views at 1920x1080. takeover-closeup drives 1.2 s before zooming for rear articulation, belts and track marks, then orbits at 1920x1080 with UI hidden. takeover-overview captures planet culling, horizon and biome presentation. Timing and visual claims require the corresponding budget/probe results and screenshot review.

[]).filter(r => !r.hidden); let maxError = 0, refError = 0, refs = 0; for (const r of recs) { const el = document.querySelector('.world-label[data-tank="' + r.tank + '"]'); if (!el) return { maxError: 1e9, refError: 1e9, labels: recs.length, refs }; const b = el.getBoundingClientRect(); maxError = Math.max(maxError, Math.hypot(b.left + b.width / 2 - host.left - r.x, b.bottom - host.top - r.y)); if (r.ref) { refs++; refError = Math.max(refError, Math.hypot(r.ref[0] - r.x, r.ref[1] - r.y)); } } return { maxError, refError: refs ? refError : 1e9, labels: recs.length, refs }; })()
